definition: Date of the situation report the row is taken from.
Level of the row: country, province or zone. The three levels overlap: filter on this column before adding up.
Province. Empty on country rows.
Health zone, as named in the latest bulletin. Empty on country and province rows.
Number of the INSP situation report (SitRep) the row is taken from.
Address of the PDF of this SitRep. Empty on a reconstructed row.

Flags a special row. “catch-up”: the difference covers more than one day (22 and 30 July). “reconstructed”: SitRep 142 was never published; the day is computed by subtraction from SitRep 143. “harmonisation”: the source corrected its series that day (Ituri: +314 earlier deaths on 30 October, removed on 31 October); the difference does not reflect new cases or deaths. “WHO Weekly Report … (manual reading)”: value read from a WHO report.
Cumulative confirmed cases since the start of the outbreak, as published by the bulletin.
Difference in cumulative cases from the previous reading for the same area. Negative: downward revision by the source. May differ from the new cases announced by the bulletin.
Number of days covered by the difference, since the previous reading for the same area (1 = from one day to the next).
Cumulative deaths since the start of the outbreak, as published by the bulletin.
Difference in cumulative deaths from the previous reading for the same area. Negative: downward revision by the source.
Case fatality rate: cumulative deaths divided by cumulative confirmed cases, in per cent.
Cumulative recoveries, published for the country only.
Confirmed deaths of the day in the community, since 13 July.
Confirmed deaths of the day in a treatment centre (ETC), since 13 July. By zone, some are not assigned to any zone and appear only under the province.
Alerts received that day, since 1 June.
Alerts validated as suspected cases that day.
Samples tested by laboratories that day.
Positive samples that day.
Positive results divided by samples tested, in per cent; only when both are published.
People hospitalised in treatment centres (ETC) that day.
Beds available in the ETCs.
Bed occupancy rate published by the bulletin; if missing, patients divided by beds.
Contacts to follow up that day.
Contacts seen that day.
Share of contacts seen, as published by the bulletin.
Cumulative people vaccinated, published by province.
